title: Jag - Far From Me Featuring Problem (Produced by Jordan Manswell)
htmlContent: [caption id="attachment_436589" align="alignnone" width="570"] Photo Credit - JAG[/caption] Jag has had one hell of a year so far back in March his record company Priority Records Collaborated with ESPN to deliver a SportsCenter Cypher that made its debut during NBA All-Star Weekend in Los Angeles.  He would follow up that with a message addressing police brutality with a single called‘The Kapernick Effect.' The visual went viral and even caught the attention of the local police in South Central Los Angeles. The release was a powerful one because it made it debut right after news of the Sacramento Police Department gunning down 22-year old Stephon Clark in his own backyard by shooting him 20 times earlier this year. The police reported that they thought he was holding a gun, but it turned out to only be a cell phone in his possession. Jag is now continuing his momentum by releasing the follow-up single to “That’s Mine” and this track is called  “Far From Me.” The single features fellow Los Angeles artist Problem and the track was produced by Jordan Manswell. Far From Me can be streamed below.
